#!/usr/bin/env ruby

require "optparse"

verbose = false
OptionParser.new do |options|
  options.on("--verbose") { verbose = true }
end.parse!

filename = ARGV.fetch(0)
contents = File.read(filename)

puts "Words: #{contents.split.size}"
